inputs.xtext_rule_text:
NonOccurrenceUsageElement returns SysML::Usage :
	  DefaultReferenceUsage
	| ReferenceUsage
	| AttributeUsage
	| EnumerationUsage
	| BindingConnectorAsUsage
	| SuccessionAsUsage
	| ExtendedUsage
;

notes: re-scoped (ADR-0015): only the sysml grammar reaches this production, so its work now lives in NonOccurrenceUsageElement@sysml
